issues.issue: The absolute bar on participating in any class action is stated without the "if arbitration is chosen" condition that qualifies the same waiver in c100.
"In any other representative capacity for others" is a catch-all following the specific examples of class representative and private attorney general, leaving its reach uncertain.

An absolute bar on joinder or consolidation is in tension with c050, under which PLS "may sue or arbitrate with one or more persons", and with c052/c074 treating the non-signatory Lender as an arbitration participant.
This organization-eligibility rule overlaps but does not match c081's differently worded exclusion, and both may disqualify the AAA default supplied by c080.
This arbitration-specific severability clause does not match the general severability-and-reformation clause in c115, and neither says which controls if the class waiver falls.

The carve-out making the arbitration agreement subject only to the FAA must be reconciled with c087 (arbitrator applies relevant law) and c085, leaving the source of law governing arbitrability and unconscionability contestable.

An integration clause limited to "the subject matter of this Agreement" is hard to apply given the separate Credit Services Disclosure Statement acknowledged in c116 and the separate loan documents with the Lender.
A signed-writing requirement for modification is in tension with c018, which contemplates refinancing on new documents, and with c046, which lets PLS waive rights without losing them.
"Reformed if practicable so as to achieve its intended purpose(s)" gives no standard for practicability or for identifying the intended purpose.
This reformation-based severability clause differs from the arbitration-specific severability rule in c108, which simply preserves the remainder without reformation.
The acknowledgment that the Agreement was received "WITH ALL NECESSARY SPACES COMPLETED" cannot be squared with c020–c024, whose price and payment blanks are unfilled.
Certifying agreement to "the binding Arbitration Agreement" at signature is in tension with c093, which allows the customer 30 days after signing to opt out of arbitration entirely.
The warranty of "no intention to file a petition for relief" turns on the customer's undisclosed state of mind, which the clause gives no way to test.

The sentence is ungrammatical ("the account on which any check ... that you provide to us is drawn, is a legitimate, open, and active account") and "legitimate" is undefined, which matters because a false warranty here bears on the criminal-conduct exception in c064.

The warranty of an open and active account interacts with c064's prohibition on pursuing criminal charges absent "forgery, fraud, theft, or other criminal conduct", since PLS could treat a returned check as a breach of this warranty.

"Any information you provide to us or that we obtain from third parties" shared "for the duration of the services or any subsequent services" leaves both the scope of the information and the duration unbounded.
The cancellation deadline runs from "the date of the transaction", whereas the attached Notice of Cancellation (c123) measures the same three days from the date the contract is signed.

"Within three days after the date the contract is signed" does not match c122's "before midnight of the third day after the date of the transaction", leaving two different deadlines in the same instrument.
The promise to return "any payment made by you under this contract" within 10 days is in tension with c021, which says the CAB fee is earned in advance at the inception of the loan.
The operative deadline is left blank ("not later than midnight on"), so the notice form states no date by which cancellation must be delivered.
